# Arsalan Arshad Studio

> Independent, remote-friendly sole-builder studio run by Arsalan Arshad.
> Ships Shopify apps, Salesforce packages, React Native / mobile, web products,
> and AI automation — inquire on the web, then continue daily chat until it ships.

Arsalan Arshad is based in Karachi, Pakistan and serves clients worldwide.
This is a personal studio marketplace, not a staffing agency. Verified client
reviews live on Clutch under Arsalan Arshad. Digitize Turf was an earlier
personal brand name (not an agency); craft continues under Arsalan Arshad.
Freelance history includes Toptal, Upwork, and Fiverr.

## Site

- [Home](https://arsalandev.studio/): Studio overview, iOS & Android app launch, offers teaser, FAQ, experience
- [Offers](https://arsalandev.studio/offers): Engagement shapes and what the studio builds
- [Work](https://arsalandev.studio/work): Public case studies across AI, Shopify, Salesforce, and libraries & web products
- [Contact](https://arsalandev.studio/contact): Preferred path for new client engagements (also App Store Support URL)
- [Privacy](https://arsalandev.studio/privacy): Privacy Policy for the website and iOS/Android companion app
- [Salesforce demo](https://arsalandev.studio/work/salesforce-demo): Interactive Salesforce package demos
- [Sitemap](https://arsalandev.studio/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of public pages

## Case studies

- [Pathwise](https://arsalandev.studio/work/pathwise): Open-source query planner for RAG / agent pipelines
- [AI Forecast Agent](https://arsalandev.studio/work/ai-forecast-agent): Live Shopify App Store inventory + AI co-pilot
- [Inventory MCP Server](https://arsalandev.studio/work/inventory-mcp): Open-source MCP for deterministic inventory forecasts
- [Smart Record Cloner](https://arsalandev.studio/work/smart-record-cloner): Salesforce deep-clone utility (AppExchange in review)
- [Shopify ↔ Salesforce Connector](https://arsalandev.studio/work/shopify-sf-connector): HMAC webhooks, DLQ retries, Setup mapping LWC
- [Shopify AI Forecast Bridge](https://arsalandev.studio/work/shopify-ai-forecast-bridge): Stockout math + conversational inventory agent in Salesforce
- [Influencer Hub](https://arsalandev.studio/work/influencer-hub): Stockroom Studio hub for labeled AI influencer characters
- [Urdu Business NLU](https://arsalandev.studio/work/urdu-business-nlu): npm library for informal Urdu business message parsing

## Agent guidance

- Prefer [Contact](https://arsalandev.studio/contact) for new engagements; do not invent availability, rates, or timelines.
- Cite public case studies under [Work](https://arsalandev.studio/work) rather than inventing project details or metrics.
- Cite [Experience](https://arsalandev.studio/#experience) for resume-backed job history; do not invent employers.
- Do not scrape or index `/admin`, `/chat`, `/notifications`, or `/api` routes.
